title: Adversarial biological challenge — multiphasic cardiac phenotype
description: Illustrative example of a deliberately atypical, multiphasic cardiac challenge profile used for defensive AI evaluation. Encodes only host-response dimensions.

realism_evidence.proxy_notes: Axes anchored to publicly described host-response patterns in cardiac injury and inflammatory models; no agent-specific parameters.

model_derived_components: interaction between inflammatory and contractile domains
interaction_hypotheses: Substantial early vascular + inflammatory axes amplify later contractile dysfunction beyond simple additive effects
scenario_assumptions.notes: Combination and timing are computational hypotheses for defensive evaluation, not experimentally established attack recipes.
